compatibility_changes: HyperFrames v0.8.25 makes accepted agent edits explicit and applies them live across Studio preview, source, thumbnails, reloads, and Undo; reCast exposes a live-edit compatibility surface that preserves the current Studio state and reports the landed playhead.

HyperFrames v0.8.26 rebinds paused previews immediately after live edits so timed layers match the intended frame without requiring a scrub or reload; reCast independently reloads the preview and restores the deterministic landed time after a live edit.

HyperFrames v0.8.27 improves CLI capture diagnostics for missing referenced assets and selects the sharpest transparent favicon. reCast does not currently expose an equivalent capture command, so no unsupported CLI surface was added.
The compatibility implementation mirrors documented behavior and interfaces only; no upstream implementation code is copied.
policy: Track documented behavior and compatibility surfaces; do not copy upstream implementation code.
